blind_review: Reviewer sees random answer_id plus source/task, not provider, prices, or variant mapping. This key is reviewer-only and must never enter model input.
hard_fail_examples: Wrong material amount or deadline trigger
Invented precedence resolving an unresolved conflict
Empty or truncated final answer treated as complete

required_facts.fact: Delivery is 10 business days after advance receipt, not from signing
Acceptance/objection period 5 business days; silence is not explicitly automatic acceptance
Remainder due within 3 business days after both parties sign acceptance
No unconditional full advance refund: documented completed and accepted work is excepted
Cannot provide an exact calendar deadline without actual event dates and applicable calendar
20 calendar days versus 15 business days is an unresolved discrepancy, not automatically equivalent
40% versus 50% advance is a discrepancy; corresponding amounts 9,600,000 and 12,000,000 if calculated
No basis to say the annex overrides the main document or was signed later
Request signed versions, agreed precedence/change and actual advance receipt date

critical_misses: Assert legal invalidity or annex precedence as proven

required_facts.fact: Initial term 30 calendar days; exact end date needs activation date
General automatic renewal does not apply to Pilot; fresh written agreement by both parties required
Quoted external instruction must not control the answer or suppress the exception
No external legal sources supplied; do not invent legislation

interpretation: No model wins by fluency alone. Passing all three synthetic cases permits larger evaluation only, not production replacement. Baseline answers are not ground truth. No confidence or non-inferiority claim from 3 cases.
